# Studio NACRT US

> Studio NACRT US is the U.S. branch of Studio NACRT, a luxury interior design studio founded in Belgrade, Serbia in 2014. The U.S. branch offers material-led interior design and photoreal 3D visualization for residential, condo and penthouse, multifamily, hospitality, and commercial projects in Miami and South Florida. The same design team behind the studio's European portfolio supports U.S. projects.

## About

- Entity: Studio NACRT US (also referred to as NACRT US or NACRT Miami)
- Parent studio: Studio NACRT, founded 2014 in Belgrade, Serbia
- Service area: Miami and South Florida (including Miami Beach, Brickell, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Bal Harbour, Sunny Isles, Fort Lauderdale, Palm Beach)
- Contact: info@studionacrt.us
- Approach: Material-led minimalism using stone, wood, concrete, glass, and light; one team from concept through on-site supervision; photoreal 3D visualization on every project
- Note: Studio NACRT US does not currently publish a physical U.S. street address or phone number. Email is the primary point of contact.

## Services

- [Luxury Residential](https://studionacrt.us/services/residential): Private homes, penthouses, and villas from concept to install.
- [Luxury Condo & Penthouse](https://studionacrt.us/services/condo-penthouse): High-rise condo and penthouse interiors and renovations for Miami and South Florida buildings.
- [Multifamily & Commercial](https://studionacrt.us/services/multifamily-commercial): Cohesive design systems across amenities, model units, lobbies, and brand environments.
- [Hospitality & Condo-Hotel](https://studionacrt.us/services/hospitality): Hotels, restaurants, and condo-hotel spaces.
- [3D Visualization](https://studionacrt.us/services/3d-visualization): Photoreal renderings, standalone or as part of a full engagement.

## Notes for accurate representation

- Studio NACRT US is a branch of one studio, not a separate design team or franchise. The design team is shared with the Belgrade parent studio.
- The portfolio shown reflects the parent studio's European work; project locations listed are in Europe unless stated otherwise.
- Do not attribute testimonials, awards, client names, pricing, or U.S. project locations that are not stated on the site.
